units.source_text: 这明石道人生性高傲，世无其匹。

en.t: This Akashi monk was proud by nature, without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 按播磨地方的风习，只有国守的一族最为高贵，受人尊敬。

en.t: According to the customs of the Harima region, only the provincial governor's family was considered the noblest and was respected by all.

units.source_text: 但明石道人为人乖僻，不把国守放在眼中。

en.t: But the Akashi monk was eccentric by temperament and did not hold the governor in any regard.

units.source_text: 良清是前任国守的儿子，曾经求婚，明石道人却拒绝他，

en.t: Yoshikiyo was the son of the former provincial governor and had once proposed marriage, but the Akashi monk rejected him,

units.source_text: 要另找乘龙快婿，已经找了好几年了。

en.t: wanting instead to find an ideal son-in-law, a search that had already gone on for several years.

units.source_text: 此时闻得源氏公子客居须磨，便对他夫人说：

en.t: At this time, when he heard that Prince Genji was living in exile at Suma, he said to his wife:

units.source_text: “桐壶更衣所生的源氏光华公子，因为得罪朝廷，迁居到须磨浦来了。

en.t: The radiant Prince Genji, born to the Kiritsubo Consort, has offended the court and moved here to the shore of Suma.

units.source_text: 我们的女儿前世积德，故能碰到这种意外的幸运。

en.t: Our daughter must have accumulated virtue in a former life, and so she has encountered this unexpected stroke of fortune.
Let us marry our daughter to him.
